evidence.quote: Owned intelligence is not the same as rented intelligence.

observations.why: The owned/rented distinction enacts market-pricing: intelligence framed as property whose mode of acquisition (own vs. rent) determines its value category.

evidence.quote: the perspective is the asset you keep.

observations.why: Calling perspective an 'asset you keep' performs proportionality — value accrues differentially to what is retained versus what is commoditized.

mints.name: AssetRetentionFraming
mints.title: the perspective is the asset you keep
mints.frame: Is value being located in what is retained rather than what is exchanged, and does that retention framing carry the relational move?
